description: This file handles creating or updating a user signature in the SuiteCRM system, including retrieving an existing signature, setting its properties, saving it, and then triggering a client-side refresh in the parent window.

classes.name: UserSignature
classes.description: A class representing user signature data and operations within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves an existing user signature record based on the provided record ID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current state of the user signature object to the database.
